ticket: POC-002 - Create Issue Tracker React frontend. Build a React and TypeScript frontend using Next.js App Router; add a header, navigation and main layout; create the home page; support backend API base URL configuration; add a reusable API client; call GET /health and display clear loading, available and unavailable states; add frontend tests; document install, configure, run and test steps. The app must install, build, start and test successfully. Issue CRUD, authentication, Docker and deployment are out of scope.
